description: Which ORDER BY keys are accepted, with which order and error numbers: a non-selected column under DISTINCT (two cases), a non-grouped column under GROUP BY, Null and a text constant as the key, a Boolean, an IIf placing Nulls, Nz, an IIf mixing Long and Text, text numbers ordered as Text and as Val, a correlated subquery, an alias equal to a source column (alias form and qualified form), several DESC keys, ASC DESC together, a repeated key, and a key from the null-extended side of an outer join? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
